row.notes: In Ne_Replay_WriteFrames, right after the recordable serialized into the scratch stream (call [rax+0x20] at 0x1445d170f) and before the holder copies: [rsp+0x118] = state holder, [rsp+0x98]-[rsp+0xa0] = state size, [rsp+0xc0]/[rsp+0xe8] = holder cur/prev buffers, [rsp+0xc8]/[rsp+0x108] = holder capacity, [rsp+0xb8,0xd0,0xd8,0xe0,0xf0,0xf8,0x100] = holder header fields, [rsp+0x198]+[rsp+0x190]+0x20 = registry slot of the holder (allocator at -8). r13 = recordable name. Used by f1_1990.dll to swap in a larger holder class when the state outgrows the holder.  Used by native/src/core/guards/session/replay_grid_guard.cpp: a state larger than the holder capacity [rsp+0x108] is cut to size 0 by writing [rsp+0x98] = [rsp+0xa0], so the memcpy at 0x1445d2570 copies nothing and the holder block is not overrun.
